page.title: Stances
page.description: One-click questions from across the forum. See what needs your vote, what's trending and what closes soon.
page.lead: One-click questions from across the forum. Vote right here, or open the discussion to see each side's replies.

empty.needs: You're all caught up. Nothing open needs your vote.
empty.trending: Nothing has had votes in the last two days.
empty.closing: Nothing has a close date coming up.

page.trending_note: Trending counts votes from the last 48 hours, with the last 6 hours counting most.
page.today: {count, plural, =0 {none today} one {+# today} other {+# today}}

card.anonymous: Anonymous: nobody can see who voted

menu.label: Block options
menu.anonymous_confirm: Make this block anonymous? Nobody, staff included, will be able to see who voted. This can't be undone.
menu.delete_confirm: Delete this block and its votes? Its line stays in the post and shows nothing. This can't be undone.
menu.reset_confirm: Delete all {count, plural, one {# vote} other {# votes}} on this block? This can't be undone.

modal.placeholder_pick: Which kickoff time should be the default?

modal.allow_change_help: Switching sides is part of a good debate.
modal.allow_remove: Members can take their vote back

gdpr.export: Stances: the member's votes and the stance blocks they added.
gdpr.delete: Stances: the member's votes and vote history are deleted and those blocks recounted. Blocks they added stay, without an author.

api.no_permission: You can't add stance blocks in this tag.

settings.types_help: The block types members can add. Switching one off keeps existing blocks of that type.
settings.results_help: Members can change this for each block.
settings.allow_change: Members can change their vote by default
settings.allow_remove: Members can take their vote back by default
settings.badges_help: New blocks show each voter's choice beside their replies unless the author turns it off.
settings.badge_rule: Which block makes a discussion's badges
settings.badge_rule_auto: The one picked, else the featured block, else the first in the opening post
settings.badge_rule_picked: Only a block the author or a moderator picks
settings.badge_rule_help: Rating and anonymous blocks never make badges.
settings.changed_tag: Show "changed" when someone switched sides after replying
settings.changed_tag_help: Hovering it shows the side they were on when they posted.
settings.list_icon: Mark discussions with a block the member hasn't voted on
settings.list_icon_help: Adds one query to each discussion list a member loads.
settings.closed_alert: Tell voters when a block closes
settings.closed_alert_help: An alert (no email) to everyone who voted, when the close date passes or someone closes it. Needs Flarum's scheduler running.

permissions.view_voters: See who voted on stance blocks
permissions.moderate: Close, reset, feature and delete any stance block
